phases.name: Strength-Hypertrophy
phases.focus: Wave loading on the main lifts: 9s, 7s, 5s across three cycles. W1 top-set 3RM triple + 2x7 back-offs (doubles as testing). W7 mid-block deload, W8-10 final push.
phases.notes: Accessories: ascending volume within each three-week wave. Anchor lifts stay stable across blocks.

phases.name: Deload / skills week
phases.focus: Deload doubling as a skills/workshop week to teach technique for the coming strength block (e.g. deadlift workshop).

phases.name: Strength
phases.focus: Two mini waves: 7-5-3 then 5-3-1. Accessories: descending volume, increasing intensity, strength-accessory emphasis.
phases.notes: End-of-block retest: one Christmas-week class testing all compounds trained through the block.

phases.name: Christmas break
phases.focus: No classes for two weeks. Detraining window: consider a maintenance option or a January return-to-training ramp.

phases.name: Unilateral muscle-endurance
phases.focus: W1 unilateral testing (newcomer influx). Single-limb work, tempo, time under tension, asymmetric holds. Higher-rep muscle endurance, addressing imbalances.

phases.name: Hypertrophy
phases.focus: Aesthetic-based goals focus. Main strength movements retained as anchors.

phases.name: Strength-Hypertrophy (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Back into the strength-hypertrophy cycle: wave loading 9-7-5, mid-block deload.

phases.name: Deload / skills week (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Deload + skills workshops prepping the strength block.

phases.name: Strength (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Mini waves 7-5-3 then 5-3-1, retest to close.

phases.name: Aerobic base

phases.name: Re-base
